decisions.source_basis: lelya- WJ/363; tië Late-Quenya sources including UT/22; -rya PE17 and VT49 sources
decisions.limits: tierya is a documented formation rather than a directly attested whole form and still needs external review.
It means pattern and does not independently express transformation, grace, release, distance, or the complete title.

decisions.source_basis: ahya- is sourced at PM/395, but the abstract noun and genitive chain are not documented
decisions.limits: Use a transparent verbal extension instead.

next_action: Source and test a transparent verbal main-title extension based on ahya-. Do not reuse Ahyaliëo and do not change production text before external specialist review.
